summary: #smallpoems People will ask me what a poem means and I will say, "What I needed it to?" And hope they walk away Yet they gawk at each allegory. A hawk hunting on gales of hidden truths like each stanza a tattoo on my soul and they rudely ask, "Wha'ts that mean?"
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#smallpoems

People
will
ask me what
  a poem means
and I will say,
"What I needed it to?"

And hope they walk
away
Yet they gawk at
each allegory. A hawk
hunting on gales
of hidden truths
like each stanza a tattoo
on my soul and they
rudely ask, "Wha'ts that mean?"
